hook: Chris Lattner started the LLVM compiler infrastructure project as a graduate student, building what became one of the most widely used open source compiler frameworks and, alongside it, the Clang C-family front end. At Apple from 2005 to 2017 he led developer tools and created the Swift programming language, remaining on the Swift Core Team until 2021. After brief stints leading Tesla's Autopilot software team and building TensorFlow infrastructure at Google, where he created the MLIR compiler infrastructure, he spent two years at the RISC-V chip company SiFive leading engineering and product. In January 2022 he co-founded Modular with Tim Davis to rebuild machine learning infrastructure from the ground up, serving as CEO and later leading development of the Mojo programming language aimed at unifying AI research and production engineering.
name: Chris Lattner

timeline.event: Begins the LLVM project as a graduate student at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
timeline.impact: Starts what becomes one of the most widely used open source compiler infrastructures

timeline.event: Joins Apple in July, eventually leading the Developer Tools department
timeline.impact: Oversees Xcode, Instruments, and the company's compilers and debuggers

timeline.event: Begins development of the Swift programming language in July
timeline.impact: Creates Apple's modern application programming language, announced publicly in 2014

timeline.event: Leaves Apple in January, briefly leads Tesla's Autopilot software team, then joins Google in August
timeline.impact: Moves into machine learning infrastructure work

timeline.event: Creates the MLIR compiler infrastructure at Google starting in April
timeline.impact: Introduces a multi-level intermediate representation later adopted broadly in ML compilers

timeline.event: Joins SiFive in January, leading engineering and product for RISC-V processor design
timeline.impact: Applies compiler and platform engineering experience to chip design tooling

timeline.event: Co-founds Modular in January with Tim Davis and becomes CEO
timeline.impact: Starts a company focused on rebuilding machine learning infrastructure, later releasing the Mojo programming language

quick_facts: Creator of the LLVM compiler infrastructure, which won the ACM Software System Award
Created the Clang compiler front end and the Swift programming language while at Apple
Created MLIR, a compiler infrastructure now widely used across the machine learning industry, while at Google
Co-founder and CEO of Modular, building AI infrastructure including the Mojo programming language
Previously worked at Tesla on Autopilot and at SiFive on RISC-V processor engineering

achievements.title: LLVM and Clang
achievements.impact: Created the open source LLVM compiler infrastructure and its Clang front end, which won the ACM Software System Award and underpins compilers across the industry.

achievements.title: Swift programming language
achievements.impact: Led creation of Apple's Swift language starting in 2010, replacing Objective-C as Apple's primary application language.

achievements.title: MLIR compiler infrastructure
achievements.impact: Created a multi-level intermediate representation at Google that became widely adopted across the machine learning compiler ecosystem.

achievements.title: Co-founder and CEO, Modular (2022-present)
achievements.impact: Built a company and the Mojo programming language aimed at unifying AI research and production infrastructure.
